searchText: meta question, will the exeicution-apis repo integrate with the EIP process? Will those changes be merged in or has it become a new path for RPC specs. Are RPC specs kind of like the ERC specs for smart contract level interactions like Token and NFT interfaces? Tentative plan is to keep execution-apis separate from the EIP process. That being said, I don't know if anyone is maintaining that repository (not that the APIs were maintained when they were EIP managed either though). We should formalize the split then and make it explicit. This may help the ERC split question. I believe it is "official", though there may be some docs that need updated. Adding notations and URLs in the relevant RPC EIPs is what I think is missing.
